basis: Myrren main (2026-11-11); visual proportions from Curse of Aros public gameplay screenshots (not original sprite files)
uncertainty: Curse of Aros native asset dimensions and internal map tile size could not be independently verified. Targets are original Myrren proposals, not asserted CoA sprite measurements.

ores.finalArtBudget: Native 22px common / 26px rare ore clusters, with single-stage integer/nearest-neighbour draw. Existing large reference PNGs remain untouched for approved art direction.
ores.note: Current rock wrapper drawRock() applies ctx.scale(0.72,0.72) OUTSIDE MyrrenEnvironment.rock() which draws 24px resource images; the effective width is 17.28 game px. Procedural 42px fallback becomes 30.24px wide and visibly changes size when the PNG loads.

bramblewood.note: starter conifer; taller than wide, broad tiers of boughs

ironbark.note: mature taller tree with open lower trunk

elderthorn.note: deliberately rare oversized ancient; branching limbs and roots

starroot.note: rare mystical tree; distinctive roots, restrained luminescence

trees.animationNote: Never animate full tree by 24 horizontal source-image slices; stable trunk, independent canopy/leaf frames at native pixel resolution.
trees.notes: Target proportions calibrated to 21x27 Kez character; common crowns 2.8–3.2 character widths and trees 2.8–3.3 character heights, not 144x144. Native final art taller than existing 96x96 square sprites; preview width may not portray new height until art is authored.

buildings.recommendation: Keep footprints/doors/collision fixed during scale study; re-evaluate 70–100px displayed facades after trees shrink.
buildings.currentVisibleIllustration: Building art renders into a 110x126 local canvas but actual house silhouette varies by shop and its roof heights; 54–88 px are base footprints, not full visible-art widths. Arms smithy is an open outdoor station instead of a closed facade.
buildings.targetVisualFacade: [approx. 70–100px width × 68–105px height] for small shops; major public structures up to 110–140px wide. Existing game/shop interaction footprints stay constant pending art review.

paths.notes: Current pathKind threshold is 13px on either side of route. Test 34px (around two tiles) as a visual-only change; retain world positions and access/collisions.

fishing.recommendation: Keep node positions, approximate 24–36px effect envelope with understated ripples/fish; future art pass.

designRule: Use coherent pixel density, original colour language, restrained outlines and native nearest-neighbour assets. Objects share a feet/ground anchor, never rescale the source with nested fractional transforms.

monsters.actual: Monsters are currently drawn by procedural per-pixel sprSlime, sprGoblin, sprWolf and sprQuad in myrren-game.js; many share approximate 12–25px silhouettes. Main boss bear species use Q_BEAR-sized artwork, not a separate native boss atlas.
monsters.note: TargetBounds [minimum width,minimum height,maximum width,maximum height] are design budgets, not existing sprite metrics. Keep collision and AI reach unchanged until sprite-review and combat QA.

camera.basis: Current world is 1600x1600, 16px tiles, 100x100 tiles; 5 built shop/station anchors around an 800x800 crater hub. Preserve saved world coordinates and screen zoom; change scenery density and distinct biomes first.
